entities.name: Djinn
entities.description: Spirits of air or fire, commonly forced into slavery by mortals to grant wishes, found across many planes and predominantly blue.

entities.name: Mahamoti Djinns
entities.description: The most regal of air spirits, who consider themselves royalty among djinns.

entities.name: Aku Djinns
entities.description: Fierce djinns used by the people of Zhalfir as protectors of the city-tomb Aku, who helped defeat Kaervek.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: A figure the Aku Djinn were instrumental in defeating.

entities.name: Marid
entities.description: The oldest and most respected tribe of djinn, the first to arrive on Dominaria from Rabiah.

entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: A plane from which the first djinn arrived on Dominaria, home to many djinn varieties.

entities.name: King Suleiman
entities.description: A ruler known for his enmity toward the djinn.

entities.name: Emberwilde Djinns
entities.description: The rulers of the fire-based plane of Wildfire, ruled by the Emberwilde Caliph.

entities.name: Emberwilde Caliph
entities.description: The ruler of the Emberwilde Djinns.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: A dragonlord whose brood conquered the Jeskai lands in Tarkir's new timeline.

entities.name: Nur
entities.description: A djinn who is an emissary of the Abzan Houses.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: The Ravnican guild that employs human/djinn hybrids.

events.summary: In Tarkir's new timeline, Ojutai and his brood conquer Jeskai lands and many djinn submit to dragon worship; after the Stormnexus Ritual, many leave the Way.
events.quote: In the new timeline, Jeskai lands were conquered by the dragonlord Ojutai and his brood, and many djinn submitted to his teachings of dragon worship.

events.summary: Several djinns join the coalition at the time of the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: At the time of the Phyrexian Invasion , several djinns joined the fight on the side of the coalition

relations.quote: As a group, they are ruled by the Emberwilde Caliph .
The marid were the first djinn to arrive on Dominaria from Rabiah .

relations.note: Known for enmity toward the djinn.
relations.quote: King Suleiman was known for his enmity toward the djinn.

rejected.quote: the djinn Nur , an emissary of the Abzan Houses
